The state archaeological complex, on the border with Castel San Vincenzo, is closed on Mondays (ticket reduced to €3 from 13 March 2026 until the completion of the works on the barriers).

Seasonal hours from Tuesday to Sunday, 10-13 and 16-20 in summer, 16-19 in winter.

Today it is a suggestive ruin among whose alleys you can walk.

pcdf7z.395: The small village of Alto Molise on the border with Abruzzo, about 960 meters on the northern slopes of Monte Miglio, destroyed by the bombings of 1943 and surrounded by woods of beech and oaks famous for the white truffle; on the mountain the polygonal walls of Sanniti, in the village the Civic Museum built with the stones of the rubble and, to the north, the astronomical observatory "Leopoldo Del Re" .
a0gkpv.677: In the upper part of the village, in a building built with stones recovered from the rubble of the bombings of 1943, exhibits the findings of the archaic necropolis of Piano Fusaro (VII-VI century BC, 25 burials and a road in use from the third century BC to the Roman age), reconstructions of kitchen, wedding room and classroom, shoemaker's shops, housekeeper, saddlemaker, winemaker, beekeeper, carpenter and blacksmith, tools of shepherdhood and wool related to transhumance, vintage clothes from the seventeenth century to today, sacred art, a large photographic archive and relics of the bombardments. Timetable indicated by italia.it: Tuesday and Saturday 10.30-13 and 15-16.30, from Wednesday to Friday 10.30-13.

1ydulba.228: On Mount Miglio there is a Sannitic fortification with three walls of polygonal walls, the Cyclopic walls testifying to the presence of the Sannites, reachable with marked paths of different difficulty, duration and starting point.

1n4vhfl.541: Inaugurated in 2002 in the historic Palazzo Mancini, it is spread over three floors with zampogne from all over the world and different eras, wind instruments, iconographic and literary documentation, historical photographs and the reconstruction of the workshop of the artisans of Scapolesi; there are also an acoustic listening room, a film library and a permanent nativity scene of the Neapolitan school of the Capuan masters of San Gregorio Armeno. A multimedia app allows you to listen to the sounds of the instruments. Timetable indicated by italia.it: Friday-Sunday 10-12 and 16-18.
